reply.text: {"say":"Chest and triceps, all cable for constant tension: a press, an incline press, and two flies up front, then three cable triceps movements to finish.","title":"Cable Chest & Triceps","days":[{"name":"Cable Chest & Triceps","exercises":[{"key":"cable-chest-press","sets":4,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Keep the stack from resting between reps"},{"key":"cable-incline-chest-press","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Press up and in, control the return"},{"key":"low-to-high-cable-fly","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Squeeze at the top, slow stretch"},{"key":"cable-crossover","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Hands finish together, no slack"},{"key":"cable-triceps-pushdown","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Elbows pinned, full lockout"},{"key":"cable-overhead-triceps-extension","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Deep stretch behind the head"},{"key":"cable-skull-crusher","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Lower slowly, keep the cable taut"}]}],"unmet":[]}
